human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Two consecutive runs can fail with the same structured runtime signature, yet a one-run diagnosis may still look retryable. Add a bounded correlation step over an explicitly supplied small set of canonical run diagnoses/reports so repeated infrastructure/runtime failures are escalated instead of recommending another blind coder retry. This is not long-term memory, monitoring, self-healing or a multi-agent runtime: no database, no background worker, no automatic remediation, and no cross-pack resume loop.
human_pressure.why_now: Repeated coder-process loss is an example where the valuable governance signal exists across runs: recurrence changes the safe next action from retrying implementation work toward stopping and repairing the runtime boundary.
do_not_misread: This pack does not introduce persistent repo intelligence or historical profiling.
Correlation consumes only the bounded run set explicitly provided by the caller/current workflow.
A repeated signature supports escalation of retry safety, not ACCEPT or proof of a specific vendor root cause.
Human review remains exceptional; deterministic STOP/repair-runtime guidance should be preferred when evidence is sufficient.
red_lines: No database or durable cross-project memory.
No producer-specific source branches or free-form log similarity.

machine_core.goal: Correlate a bounded caller-supplied set of structured run failure signatures and escalate retry recommendations when the same runtime/infrastructure class recurs without evidence of meaningful state change.
red_lines: Signature construction must use closed structured fields, never embeddings or free-form message similarity.
Do not scan arbitrary repository history; correlation input must be explicitly bounded by the caller.
Do not escalate different root-cause classes merely because both runs failed.
Do not convert repeated failure into proof of an unobserved specific cause.
invariants: One isolated failure remains distinguishable from repeated recurrence.
Only equivalent structured failure signatures count as recurrence.
Repeated runtime/process-supervision failures can make another coder retry unsafe/ineffective without changing acceptance semantics.
Correlation recommendations are advisory/read-only and cannot edit repository or runtime state.
Input cardinality is bounded and no durable memory is required.

producer.artifact: bounded list of canonical run diagnoses/reports

observable_effect.assertion: When the same structured runtime failure signature recurs across the supplied run set, Ailuros marks blind coder retry as unsafe/ineffective and recommends bounded stop/runtime-repair escalation without fabricating a more specific cause.

proofs.assertion: Two process-supervision failures with equivalent structured signatures produce repeated=true and a stop/repair-runtime recommendation rather than another blind coder retry.
A process failure followed by an unrelated scope failure is not treated as repeated identical runtime failure.
Correlation operates only on the supplied finite input and performs no persistent/history discovery.
Producer source-label changes do not affect signature equality when canonical structured facts are unchanged.

failure_semantics: If signatures lack enough structured fields for equivalence, report recurrence=unknown/not_proven rather than matching by prose.
If later evidence proves a materially different failure class, do not carry forward an earlier escalation blindly.
If a safe deterministic recommendation cannot be derived from recurrence, surface human_review rather than inventing remediation.
Correlation never overrides validation/scope/acceptance gates and never returns ACCEPT.

steps.title: Define the smallest structured failure signature
details: Derive signature fields from the diagnosis/canonical report contract introduced by 8085 or existing equivalents.
Prefer fields such as root-cause class, failing phase, structured failure code and actor/component when present.
Exclude timestamps, run ids, vendor prose and incidental payload fields that would defeat deterministic equivalence.

steps.title: Correlate only bounded supplied runs
details: Accept a finite list/sequence from the caller and compare adjacent/relevant diagnoses deterministically.
Do not read a database, global history directory or repository memory to discover more runs.
Return recurrence count/signature plus evidence references sufficient for operator explanation.

steps.title: Escalate retry safety conservatively
details: For repeated runtime/process-supervision signatures without evidence of a corrective state change, recommend STOP/repair-runtime or the nearest existing bounded action vocabulary.
Do not spend another coder execution merely because attempts remain if the repeated evidence says implementation work cannot address the failure.
Keep different failure classes separate and do not infer a common cause from generic failure status.

steps.title: Expose concise operator evidence
details: Show that the escalation is based on N equivalent structured failures and identify the affected layer.
Keep output compatible with the four-question diagnosis/report surface where possible.
Add tests proving no persistence, no automatic action execution and source neutrality.

acceptance: Equivalent repeated process/runtime signatures are detected deterministically from bounded supplied inputs.
Repeated runtime failure no longer recommends a blind coder retry by default.
Different failure classes are not falsely correlated.
No DB, background monitor, history crawler, long-term memory or automatic remediation is added.
Producer labels do not affect signature equality.
Acceptance/governance gates remain unchanged and the correlation layer never returns ACCEPT.
Full tests, ruff and mypy pass.

must_check: Correlation is finite/caller-supplied and creates no long-term memory or monitoring subsystem.
Signature equality is based only on structured canonical diagnosis/report fields.
Repeated runtime failure changes retry guidance without inventing a specific vendor cause.
Different failure classes are not conflated.
No automatic remediation, repository writes or ACCEPT path is introduced.
Forbidden files are untouched and all validation passes.
reject_if: A database, durable history index, background monitor or repo-intelligence system is added.
Free-form text similarity or embeddings determine recurrence.
The feature automatically edits/retries/fixes code instead of reporting bounded guidance.
Repeated failure is treated as proof of an unobserved API/vendor/OOM cause.
Correlation can produce ACCEPT or bypass validation/scope gates.
Validation fails or forbidden files change.
